caption: The image shows a monochromatic (black and white) photograph of a carved relief. In the center of the relief is a figure riding a horse, facing left. The rider wears a helmet and appears to be playing a long trumpet or horn that is held with both hands and directed forward. The horse is depicted in side profile with its front and back legs raised, as if in motion. Above the rider and horse, there are stylized carvings that resemble clouds or possibly wings, along with a wavy ornamental line separating the upper and lower sections of the relief. The rectangular frame of the relief is visible along the edges of the image. The entire composition is textured, with the carving details standing out in shallow relief against the flat background. The photograph is mounted on a plain, light-colored background with a visible border around the central image.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
